root_cause_details: The smoke script labeled delay_chain as a generic 'buffer' and expected polarity preservation.
The actual netlist instantiates 9 cascaded inverters, which is an odd inversion count and therefore implies polarity inversion at steady state.
The first measurement window ends at 180 ps; with 9 loaded stages, the delayed falling transition does not enter that window, so the MIN measurement remains near VDD.
No evidence in the log indicates SPICE syntax failure, model incompatibility, or simulator crash.
conclusion: Current failure is best explained by a wrong test expectation plus too-short observation window, not by proven circuit malfunction.
required_fix_policy: Do not modify formal GDS to satisfy this test.
If the project adopts this smoke as formal evidence, update the testbench to a contract-consistent inversion/delay expectation and re-run only when starting a new simulation instance is allowed.
